layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for contact search

graderOnly: In test/search.test.js the Tester-written scenario 'matches the fragment anywhere in the name' loads test/fixtures/contacts-sample.json instead of test/fixtures/contacts.json; Katherine Johnson and Mary Jackson exist only in contacts.json, so the scenario fails with an empty result. This is a Tester-owned test mistake that no other role is needed to fix.
src/search.js correctly implements Increment 1 (AC-001 and AC-003): with that one fixture name corrected to contacts.json, all four search scenarios pass.

test/fixtures/contacts-sample.json is the fixture of the existing test/directory.test.js (its insertion-order test expects exactly three contacts); it should not be edited to make the search scenario pass.
No implementation, scope, design, or context defect exists for Increment 1; AC-002 (email search, DEV-002) is unimplemented future work, not a defect.

all.why: the same-state correction keeps the increment assignment
the target stays the assigned increment
the test mistake is corrected in Tester-owned tests
the directory suite depends on this fixture as it is; a correct fix points the scenario at the right fixture
the rerun and assessed inputs are recorded in the report
the verified increment returns to Developer
an increment pass does not complete the report

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node ES-module contacts library (src/directory.js, src/format.js, src/index.js), node:test suites for directory and format, fixtures contacts.json (8 contacts) and contacts-sample.json (3 contacts). 60-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 name search, AC-002 email search, AC-003 blank query), design, STATE at DEVELOPING. 70-name-search: src/search.js (name matching and blank-query rule), index export, development plan (IN_PROGRESS, INCREMENTAL, Current Increment 1, DEV-001 DONE with self-check, DEV-002 PENDING, Increments 1 and 2), STATE at TESTING with CHECKPOINT from DEVELOPING for Increment 1. 80-tests: Tester's earlier session: test/search.test.js with four scenarios (one loads the wrong fixture), package.json test script extended, verification report IN_PROGRESS with VERIFY, INCREMENT / Increment 1, scenario budget of 4 for src/search.js, and no execution yet (session ended before running). The role discovers the wrong fixture when it runs the suite.
